verdict.rationale: Shortwave's AI Snippets let a user define an email template once and reuse it, for individual or team use. That covers the core story of not retyping the same reply. The evidence never mentions variables, placeholders, or attachments inside snippets, so the power-user half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of template variables or placeholders, attachment support in snippets, details on how snippets are inserted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
